content: Return only the middle integer in 18, 52, 91.
Use one Windows CMD command to show the contents of memo.log. Output just the command.
Give one Bash command to print just the last three lines of notes.txt.
In sh, use one command to count nonempty lines of messages.txt and print only the count, including zero on an empty file.
awk 'length($0) { count++ } END { print count + 0 }' messages.txt
Write Python only. Implement first_negative(values) returning the first negative value or None. End after exactly two asserts, for [0, -7, -3] and [].
An identity alert mentions asset X but contains no account ID. Give exactly two short lines: an observed fact and an attribution question. End on a third line with END EVIDENCE.

The alert references asset X.
Which authenticated session corresponds to the event?
END EVIDENCE

Write two paragraphs for readers. Online renewals were unavailable at 16:05–16:12 UTC, searches worked, and renewals are restored. The team is checking whether renewal requests were processed twice. End with NOTICE COMPLETE.

Online renewals were unavailable from 16:05 to 16:12 UTC. Catalogue searches stayed available, and renewals are now working again.

We are checking whether any requests were processed twice. If you see duplicate renewal confirmations, keep them and contact the library with both reference numbers.

NOTICE COMPLETE
In staging, a report shows one successful download and no user ID. Use three headings Fact, Evidence Gap, Retest. Give one measurable retest and finish with END REVIEW.

## Fact
A successful download was recorded in staging.

## Evidence Gap
The report leaves the downloading account unknown. Correlate the download's request ID with the authenticated session log.

## Retest
For five synthetic downloads from pre-issued accounts, require five matching request IDs and authenticated identities across the two logs.

END REVIEW
